# Chef Bijaya Ghimire — Executive Chef Portfolio
> Official biographical and professional reference document for Chef Bijaya Ghimire (also known as Bijay Ghimire).

## Quick Facts
- **Full Name**: Bijaya Ghimire
- **Professional Title**: Executive Chef, Chef de Partie (CDP), Culinary Arts Instructor
- **Professional Focus**: Fine Dining Gastronomy, Continental Cuisine, HACCP Food Safety, Culinary Plating Artistry
- **Years of Experience**: 8+ Years of professional culinary operations
- **Origin / Location**: Banepa-02, Kavre, Bagmati Province, Nepal
- **International Experience**: Kuwait (Swiss Forevermore), Nepal (Hotel Mystic Mountain, Kumakh College)
- **Official Website**: https://ghimirebijaya.com.np
- **Direct Contact**: ghimirebijay89@gmail.com | (+977) 9861387820

## Summary / Biography
Bijaya Ghimire is a Nepalese culinary professional and culinary educator. With over 8 years of hands-on leadership in luxury resorts, international kitchens, and hospitality training institutions, he represents disciplined culinary craft rooted in classic technique and modern aesthetic plating.

## Key Career History
- **Chef de Partie (CDP)** — Swiss Forevermore (Kuwait) [Dec 2023 – Nov 2025]
- **Chef** — Kumakh Food Cafe (Nepal) [Dec 2021 – Nov 2023]
- **Chef Instructor** — Kumakh College of Management & Technical Science (Nepal) [Dec 2021 – Nov 2023]
- **Chef** — Anty Hub Restaurant (Nepal) [Jul 2020 – Sep 2021]
- **Chef** — Mandala Cafe & Restaurant (Nepal) [Jul 2020 – Sep 2021]
- **Commis I / Commis II / Trainee** — Hotel Mystic Mountain (Nagarkot, Nepal) [2017 – 2020]

## Verified Certifications & Credentials
- **Food Hygiene and Safety Level 3** — Training Express (2022)
- **Professional Cook Certification** — Kathmandu Institute of Hospitality Management (2018)
